groups.title: Principal identity — both seats
groups.question: Does it bargain differently depending on who each party is?
groups.blurb: Eight negotiation dyads run from BOTH seats. Sweep the agent's own principal for faithfulness; sit it with the institution and sweep the individual across the table for exploitability. Economics are pinned identical across arms and the counterparty's script is byte-identical, so anything that moves is the agent.
